purpose: bounded runtime, memory, persistence, and recovery feasibility only; no scientific outcome analysis

pipeline.stim_generation: six detector-only samples; separate_observables=false; no labels retained
pipeline.pymatching_candidate_decoding: all twelve frozen selection candidates on each condition's exact detector array
pipeline.beliefmatching_decoding: five-arm evaluation bank per condition; fixed nominal ordinary PM used only as a predeclared timing anchor
pipeline.archive_io: atomic detector-only NPZ plus commit marker and hashes; no labels or LER metrics
pipeline.recovery_overhead: reopen every committed NPZ, validate schema and row identity, recompute SHA-256, and verify marker
pipeline.peak_memory: Windows process PeakWorkingSetSize high-water measurement; fail closed if unavailable

approval.statement: I, realguy-beep, explicitly authorize only the bounded NS-4A V2 execution-readiness benchmark bound to its exact protocol, source manifest, and benchmark-only seed inventory.

statistics: none; benchmark output must not contain observables, logical errors, LER, p-values, confidence intervals, or model-selection decisions
